newsitem.title: UK: R-OPTIONS - FTSE calls active after December expiry.
newsitem.headline: R-OPTIONS - FTSE calls active after December expiry.

text.p: FTSE 100 index options were actively traded on Friday after the 1030 GMT expiry of December options on the blue chip index, options specialists said.
In American-style options activity was focused on the January 4,200 calls, where some 8,373 lots were traded, while in the European style 7,029 of the January 4,325 calls were dealt.
Dealers reported little activity in individual stock options. "All the activity has been in the FTSE," said one, "and since expiry it has gone very quiet."
The FTSE 100 was up 37.6 points at 4,088.9 by 1409 GMT after reaching a record 4,097.1 in early trading.
